scientific_integrity: Proof and exact source comparison are supplied. Verification script uses exact symbolic factorizations, independently computed angular quadratures and seeded direct-Gaussian simulations; finite tests are not used as infinite proof. The closed spectral results and tight constants are assessments requiring independent confirmation.
scientific_limitations: Only real positive-definite 2 by 2 matrices, exactly two independent standard Gaussian queries, and the basic unnormalized XNysTrace estimator. No full-rank-information-theoretic optimality claim: two matrix-vector products can reconstruct a 2 by 2 matrix. The source recommends an optional normalized estimator which is different and becomes exact in this special dimension. No independent validation or exhaustive publication-precedence certification.
title: Exact planar Gaussian XNysTrace risk and posterior-error calibration
